guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.crime.spot.1: Stop, thief! Stop in the name of the law!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.crime.spot.3: Halt! In the name of the crown!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.crime.spot.4: Wanted! Don't let them get away!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.crime.fight.1: Hands where I can see them!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.crime.fight.3: You're under arrest. Don't make this worse.
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.crime.fight.4: Yield, and you'll keep your teeth.
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.hostile.spot.0: You're not welcome here! Turn back!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.hostile.spot.1: Stranger at the gate! Eyes on them!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.hostile.spot.2: Another step and we draw steel!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.hostile.spot.3: We know your face. Get out!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.hostile.spot.4: Keep walking, outsider. Away from here.
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.hostile.fight.1: Leave these lands or fall here!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.hostile.fight.2: This is our home. Not yours!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.brawl.spot.4: There's a fight! Break it up!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.brawl.fight.4: Lay a hand on them again, I dare you.
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.war.spot.1: Their soldiers are here! Sound the call!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.war.spot.2: Soldiers on the road! Form up!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.war.spot.3: War's come to us! Everyone up!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.war.many.0: They've brought an army! Hold together!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.war.many.1: Too many of them! Close ranks!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.war.many.2: More of them over the rise! Form up!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.war.many.4: Call every blade! They're all coming!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.raider.spot.2: Cutthroats on the road! To arms!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.raider.fight.2: Back to whatever hole you crawled from!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.raider.fight.3: Cut them down before they reach the houses!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.raider.fight.4: Thieves and butchers, the lot of you!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.raider.many.0: It's a whole raid! Everyone up!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.raider.many.1: They're coming from all sides! Hold!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.raider.many.2: Too many raiders! I need blades here!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.raider.many.3: Barricade the doors! Hold them back!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.raider.many.4: Their whole band is here! Rally to me!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.undead.spot.1: Corpses on their feet! Wake the others!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.undead.spot.4: I can smell them from here. The dead are up.
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.undead.fight.3: You've no business among the living!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.undead.many.0: A horde of the dead! Hold the line!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.undead.many.1: There's too many of them! Fall in together!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.undead.many.2: The graves are emptying! Shields up!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.undead.many.4: Dead everywhere! Don't let them bite!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.undead.kill.1: Back to the dirt with you.
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.undead.kill.4: One less corpse on its feet.
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.crawler.spot.2: Big legs, coming fast! Look out!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.crawler.fight.2: Get off the wall and fight!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.crawler.fight.3: Ugh, so many legs! Hit it!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.crawler.many.0: A whole nest of them! Hold together!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.crawler.many.2: More of them on the walls! Burn them out!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.crawler.many.3: It's a swarm! Don't get cornered!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.crawler.many.4: They're crawling out of the dark! Hold!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.crawler.kill.3: That's one less to crawl in my boots.
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.crawler.kill.4: Done. Somebody check my back for more.
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.creeper.spot.3: Green devil coming! Clear the street!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.creeper.spot.4: Creeper! Don't let it near the houses!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.creeper.kill.3: That one won't be blowing anything up.
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.brute.spot.0: That's a big one! Call the others!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.brute.spot.2: By the gods, look at the size of it!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.brute.spot.3: Something big's coming! Everyone, to me!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.brute.spot.4: Brute at the edge! All blades here!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.brute.fight.2: Hit it, then get out of its reach!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.brute.fight.3: Surround it! Don't stand in front!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.brute.kill.2: That's a tale for the tavern.
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.brute.kill.4: Somebody help me get my breath back.
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.monster.spot.3: Beast of the dark, coming our way!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.monster.spot.4: Monster near the houses! To me!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.monster.fight.3: Back to the dark with you!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.monster.many.0: There's a pack of them! Rally!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.monster.many.1: More coming out of the dark! Hold together!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.monster.many.2: We're overrun! I need blades here!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.monster.many.3: So many of them! Stand fast!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.beast.spot.1: There's an animal on the loose! Watch yourselves!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.beast.spot.3: Beast near the folk! Get them inside!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.beast.fight.3: Keep it away from the folk!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.beast.many.1: There's more of them in the grass!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.beast.many.4: Watch the flanks! They hunt together!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.beast.kill.2: Poor thing. It had to be done.
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.beast.kill.4: Down. Check it's not got young about.
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.animal.spot.2: Get that thing back in its pen!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.animal.spot.3: Something's run off from the fields!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.animal.fight.2: It's gone wild! Bring it down!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.help.1: To me! I can't hold alone!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.help.4: I could use some support over here!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.disaster.quake.0: Earthquake! Get out from under the roofs!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.disaster.quake.1: The ground's shaking! Into the open!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.disaster.quake.3: Quake! Keep clear of the towers!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.disaster.flood.2: Get the children up the hill!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.disaster.wave.0: The sea! The sea's coming in!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.disaster.wave.3: The water's pulled back! Get to high ground!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.disaster.storm.1: Get inside and bar the shutters!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.disaster.storm.2: Get the animals in! Storm's coming!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.disaster.storm.3: Indoors! Don't stand in the open!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.disaster.storm.4: Cover your faces and get inside!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.disaster.fire_sk: Fire from the sky! Take cover!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.disaster.slide.1: Slide! Get clear of the slope!
guardcry.jaymoskingdoms.disaster.slide.4: Get out of the valley! Now!
